description.zh: 按住右键、中键或侧键画一下，或配合另一个鼠标键做组合手势：后退、关窗口、切标签页；选中文字后画一下或按快捷键：复制、搜索、翻译；画个圈、推到屏幕角落、在屏幕边上来回蹭、按住手势键滚滚轮，都能设成按键、打开程序、输入文字或关机重启。可以只在某个程序里、某个角落里生效。管理员身份运行的窗口里用不了
description.en: Hold the right, middle or side button and draw, or combine with a second mouse button: back, close the window, switch tabs. Select words, then draw or press a shortcut: copy, search, translate. Circles, the screen's corners and edges, and the wheel with a trigger button held can press keys, open programs, type text, shut down or restart. A rule can hold in one program or one corner only. Not in windows run as administrator

notes.zh: 空闲时为快速打开预留的内存最多 64 MB（#459），用 Win顺 0.46.0 的共用代码和插件开发包重新编译。权限不变。
notes.en: At most 64 MB kept in memory for a quick opening at rest (#459); rebuilt with WinShun 0.46.0's shared code and plugin SDK. Permissions unchanged.
